Slow Burn Options
Physical Activity Impact
Multiplier for how much physical activities affect fever (0.0 = no effect, 0.5 = half effect, 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = double effect)
Enable Debug Mode
Show detailed debug information in console. Only enable for troubleshooting or development.
Disable Close Proximity Wake
When enabled, zombies won't automatically wake up when you get within 1 tile of them. Your disguise holds even at very close range.
No Suspicion for Zombie-Walk Running

When enabled, running while in Zombie Walk Mode generates zero extra suspicion (instead of a reduced amount). Intended for games using the 'Sprinters' zombie speed setting, where a running shuffle isn't unusual. Off by default.
Days Until Terminal (Baseline)
How many in-game days until terminal fever if you do nothing but rest in ideal conditions (20-365 days)
Enable Fever System
Enables the slow-burning fever mechanic. This replaces the base game fever system for Slow Burn players. When disabled, temperature progression is completely turned off.
Fever Progression Speed
Multiplier for how quickly your fever progresses (0.1 = 10% speed, 1.0 = normal based on death days, 5.0 = 500% speed)
Starting Fever Temperature
Your starting body temperature in Celsius (37.0 = normal human, 37.2 = infected, 40.0 = severe fever)
Medicinal Herb Spawn Rate
Multiplier for medicinal herb spawn rates when foraging (0.1 = very rare, 1.0 = normal, 3.0 = abundant)
Grunt Cooldown (Real Seconds)
How many real-world seconds you must wait between uses of the groan (V key).
Grunt Suspicion Reduction
How much suspicion is removed each time you groan like a zombie (V key).
Gut Covering Duration (Hours)
How many in-game hours the gut covering effect lasts (0.5 = 30 minutes, 2.0 = 2 hours, 24.0 = full day)
Gut Covering Fever Penalty
Fever progression speed increase when covered in guts (0.0 = no penalty, 0.1 = 10% faster, 1.0 = 100% faster)
Gut Covering Suspicion Multiplier
Suspicion multiplier when covered in zombie guts (0.0 = no suspicion, 0.5 = half suspicion, 1.0 = no benefit)
Herbal Medicine Effectiveness
Multiplier for herbal remedy effectiveness (0.1 = 10% effective, 1.0 = normal, 3.0 = 300% effective)
Modern Medicine Spawn Rate
Multiplier for modern medicine spawn rates in containers (0.0 = never spawns, 1.0 = normal, 3.0 = abundant)
Zombie Detection Distance
How many tiles away zombies can detect your suspicious movements (5-30 tiles)
Naked Horde Chance
Percentage chance of a naked horde spawning on each check (0-100%).
Naked Horde Despawn Distance
How many tiles away a naked horde's zombies are removed to manage population.
Enable Naked Hordes

Periodically spawns a moving cluster of naked zombies passing near you. Unlike ordinary zombies, Naked Horde members do not respect your disguise -- they behave like normal, fully alert zombies and will notice and attack you if you don't stay out of their way.
Naked Horde Check Interval (Real Minutes)
How often, in REAL-WORLD minutes (not in-game time), the game rolls a chance to spawn a naked horde. Using real time keeps the pacing consistent regardless of your DayLength sandbox setting.
Naked Horde Maximum Size
Largest number of zombies in a naked horde.
Naked Horde Minimum Size
Smallest number of zombies in a naked horde.
Spawn Naked Horde at Game Start
Forces one naked horde to spawn and pass near your starting location the first time a character spawns.
Naked Horde Spawn Distance
How many tiles away from you a naked horde spawns.
Naked Zombie Percentage

Percentage of ordinary zombies that spawn stripped of their worn clothing (0-100%). Purely cosmetic -- these zombies still fully respect your disguise, unlike Naked Horde members, which are always naked and always dangerous.
Combat Alert Radius
When you attack a zombie, others within this many tiles will also wake up and attack (0 = only target, 10 = large group response)
Show Exact Temperature
Display your exact fever temperature in moodle tooltips instead of just fever stage.
Smart Zombie Percentage
Percentage of 'smart' zombies that can instantly see through your disguise no matter what (0-50%)
Suspicion Recovery Rate
Multiplier for how quickly suspicion decreases when hiding (0.1 = 10% speed, 1.0 = normal, 5.0 = 500% speed)
Suspicion Gain Rate
Multiplier for how quickly suspicion increases from actions (0.1 = 10% speed, 1.0 = normal, 5.0 = 500% speed)
Weapon Suspicion Multiplier
Multiplier for suspicion generated when equipping weapons near zombies (0.0 = no penalty, 1.0 = normal, 3.0 = triple penalty)
Enable Weather Effects
Weather conditions affect fever progression. Rain and cold slow progression, heat accelerates it.
Blunt Weapon Head Crit Scale

How much of a blunt weapon's damage rating converts into bleed damage when a critical hit lands on the head specifically -- a solid crack to the skull can draw blood even without a blade. Always rolls as a Normal wound with no skill scaling. Any other blunt hit (body or a non-critical head hit) never bleeds (0.0 = disabled, 0.02 = default).
Critical Hit Bleed Multiplier

How much stronger a Graze or Normal bleed is when the hit that caused it was a critical hit (the game's own 'good hit' roll, already unique per weapon). Does not affect Devastating wounds, which are already always fatal (1.0 = no bonus, 2.5 = default).
Devastating Wound Bleed Rate

A Devastating wound is always fatal. This is the percentage of the zombie's remaining health removed each second once that happens -- higher kills faster. A hard time limit still forces death a few seconds after a Devastating wound regardless of this setting (0.05 = slowest, 0.35 = default, 1.0 = fastest).
Enable Zombie Bleed-Out

A solid hit from a bladed weapon, piercing tool, or firearm can make a zombie bleed out over time on top of the normal damage it takes -- it keeps fighting while it happens. Every qualifying hit rolls how deep the wound is (see the Devastating/Graze Chance options below).
Graze Wound Time Before Clot Check

How many real seconds a Graze wound bleeds unconditionally before it's even eligible for the one-time clot roll below. Prevents a Graze from resolving itself away almost immediately and being pointless (0 = eligible instantly, 10 = default).
Graze Wound Clot Chance

Once a Graze wound has bled for the time above, this is the one-time percentage chance it clots shut and stops for good. If it fails, it keeps bleeding at the low Graze rate until the zombie dies -- no further clot rolls happen for that wound (0% = every Graze eventually kills, 35% = default, 100% = every Graze clots after the time limit).
Graze Wound Damage Scale

How much of a weapon's own damage rating converts into bleed damage per second for a hit that rolled as a Graze. Deliberately weak -- a Graze alone should rarely kill without stacking more hits (0.0 = no bleed, 0.004 = default, 0.5 = maximum).
Head Hit: Devastating Wound Chance

Percentage chance that a qualifying hit to the head rolls as a Devastating wound. Higher than the torso equivalent by default -- a solid hit to the head is more likely to be lethal (0-100%, 20% = default).
Head Hit: Graze Chance
Percentage chance that a qualifying hit to the head rolls as a minor Graze. Lower than the torso equivalent by default -- a head hit is less likely to be a shrug-off (0-100%, 40% = default).
Max Graze/Normal Bleed Per Second

Caps how much bleed damage per second a single zombie can accumulate from Graze wounds, and separately from Normal wounds, even from repeated hits, so stacking wounds of the same depth can't produce an absurd instant kill. Does not cap Devastating wounds (2.0 = default).
Normal Wound Time Before Clot Check

How many real seconds a Normal wound bleeds unconditionally before it's even eligible for its own one-time clot roll below. Much longer than the Graze equivalent by default -- a Normal wound is meant to usually kill (0 = eligible instantly, 30 = default).
Normal Wound Clot Chance

Once a Normal wound has bled for the time above, this is the one-time percentage chance it clots shut and stops for good. Low by default -- most Normal wounds are still meant to kill, this just allows a rare few to clot given enough time. Devastating wounds never clot regardless of this setting (0% = every Normal wound eventually kills, 5% = default).
Normal Wound Damage Scale

How much of a weapon's own damage rating converts into bleed damage per second for a hit that rolled as a Normal wound -- the 'solid hit' case, usually enough to bleed a zombie out on its own given time (0.0 = no bleed, 0.03 = default, 1.0 = maximum).
Skill Shift: Devastating Share

Of the percentage shifted out of Graze chance by skill level, the fraction that goes to Devastating chance instead of Normal chance (0.0 = all goes to Normal, 0.4 = default, 1.0 = all goes to Devastating).
Enable Skill-Based Wound Scaling

A more skilled attacker gets better odds of a Normal or Devastating wound instead of a Graze. Only the one real skill governing the weapon actually in hand matters -- a Short Blade 6 / Aiming 1 character gets the Short Blade 6 bonus with a knife, but only the Aiming 1 bonus with a pistol.
Skill Odds Shift Per Level

Percentage points moved out of the Graze chance per skill level (0-10) in the relevant weapon skill, split between Normal and Devastating below (0.0 = skill has no effect, 2.5 = default, 10.0 = a single level can shift a third of a typical Graze chance).
Torso Hit: Devastating Wound Chance
Percentage chance that a qualifying hit to the torso rolls as a Devastating wound -- always fatal, ignores the per-tick cap, can't clot (0-100%, 5% = default).
Torso Hit: Graze Chance

Percentage chance that a qualifying hit to the torso rolls as a minor Graze -- weak bleed that can clot shut on its own. Whatever's left after this and the Devastating chance rolls as a Normal wound (0-100%, 70% = default).
Infected Window Break Bleed Chance
Percentage chance of cutting yourself on the glass when using Infected Window Break (0-100%).
Infected Window Break Gloves Bleed Multiplier
Multiplier applied to the bleed chance when wearing gloves (0.0 = fully protected, 0.1 = massively reduced, 1.0 = no protection).
Infected Window Break Max Duration (Seconds)
Longest possible time (in real seconds) breaking a window bare-handed like a zombie can take -- randomized each time between the min and this.
Infected Window Break Min Duration (Seconds)
Shortest possible time (in real seconds) breaking a window bare-handed like a zombie can take -- randomized each time between this and the max.
